rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for sustained personal commitment to a job, cause, or activity.

example.english: I have a lot of dedication to this job.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 hou2 tau4 jap6

rows.note: Use this for the care and effort someone puts into doing something, especially when praising the quality of the work.

example.english: You put a lot of dedication into this report.
example.traditional: 呢份報告睇得出你落咗好多用心。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 tai2 dak1 ceot1 nei5 lok6 zo2 hou2 do1 jung6 sam1

rows.note: Use this when the dedication involves giving oneself or one's efforts to a cause or to other people.

example.english: They devoted their whole life to education, showing great dedication.
example.traditional: 佢一世人都奉獻畀教育事業。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 sai3 jan4 dou1 fung6 hin3 bei2 gaau3 juk6 si6 jip6

rows.note: Use this only for a written dedication addressed to someone at the front of a book or other work.

example.english: There is a dedication at the front of this book to my mentor.
example.traditional: 呢本書前面有一段獻詞，送畀我恩師。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 cin4 min6 jau5 jat1 dyun6 hin3 ci4 sung3 bei2 ngo5 jan1 si1
